name: No-till establishment

soft_risks.risk: Weed pressure rises and nitrogen can be temporarily immobilised in the residue layer
soft_risks.mitigation: Plan weed management for the first seasons and adjust nitrogen timing

soft_risks.risk: Direct seeding usually needs a seed drill the farm may not have
soft_risks.mitigation: Share equipment through a cooperative or start with reduced tillage instead

mechanism: Leaving the soil undisturbed keeps aggregates and residue intact, so water infiltrates and stays and carbon is not exposed to rapid oxidation.

region_variants.note: FAO reports cover crops do not reduce cash crop yields under no-tillage in semiarid regions because evapotranspiration is lower.
